title: QA: The Demand in the Ledger
eyebrow: QA for #446 and #456 · branch AjsAgent/demand-ledger-page-419 · no pull request yet, not merged

unverified: Nobody has played it by hand yet: every check was run by a script.
Dying while carrying the page is wired but was never played: the checks drop it with Q, not by dying.
Q with loot in hand still dropping the loot (and not the page) is covered by a rule test, not in play.
The demanded piece is always the Arm Reliquary, and the raids left come from a test setting, until the demand itself (#419) supplies both.

short.lead: The ledger now shows only the drawing and "The Ophan demands", glowing white, amber or red. Pressing E tears the drawing out, R raises it while you walk, Q drops it and F picks it up, and coming home puts it back in the book. Both pages are plain vellum, and the tear is ragged. Every script check passed; the full suites are green.
short.hint: Tap an item to see what was checked and what you can try yourself.
items: Only "The Ophan demands", white / amber / red (#447)
Pictures of all three colours were taken in game and looked at; the brightness swells and fades, faster and brighter when due. Tests 2/2.
Look at the book from the table: is the glow noticeable enough from across the Lair?
No numerals, bars or ruled lines (#457)
The ledger model was rebuilt with two plain vellum pages and its red ribbon. Pictures of the whole and torn book show no print.
E on the book; a ragged stub stays (#448, #458)
The two-player check had the client tear the page; both machines agreed who holds it and both showed the stub. Tests 3/3 and 3/3.
Press E on the book. Does the tear look ripped enough?
Hold R to hold the drawing up while walking (#449)
Raised in the Lair and in a raid; walking with R held moved the player. Tests 2/2.
Hold R in a raid and walk.
Q drops it, F picks it up, home puts it back (#450)
Two-player check: the client dropped it and the host picked it up, then the other way round; a page left lying was back in the book on both machines after coming home. Tests 4/4.
Drop it with Q in a raid and pick it up with F.
EditMode: 264 passed, 0 failed, 3 skipped. PlayMode: 545 of 545 passed. The two-player Lair check: PASS all Lair checks (run demand-458).
